connect.title: Ku xidh LinkedIn
connect.intro: Ku gal akoontada LinkedIn ee maamusha xayaysiisyadaada. Leadrat waxa uu akhriyaa oo kaliya xisaabaha xayaysiiskaaga, Lead Gen Form hagaynta iyo xisaabaadka xayaysiiska, oo waxa uu soo diraa beddelka aad shid
connect.need1: Doorka koontada xayeysiiska ee LinkedIn (Daawade ama ka sareeya).
connect.need2: Doorka bogga shirkadda ee ku xidhan (Maamulaha, Lead Gen Forms Manager , Content Admin , Curator ama Analyst) LinkedIn waxay u baahan tahay inay la wadaagto hoggaanka.
connect.need3: Su'aasha lambarka taleefoonka ee Lead Gen Forms - horseed aan lahayn nambar telefoon laguma dari karo.

connection.title: Isku xirka
connection.autoRenews: Helitaanka si toos ah ayay u cusboonaysiinaysaa ilaa markaas
connection.noAutoRenew: Gelitaanku si toos ah uma cusboonaysiiyo
connection.syncResult: Isku xidhka la sameeyay: {{received}} waa la helay, {{created}} la sameeyay, {{duplicates}} nuqul, {{rejected}} waa diiday.
connection.confirmDisconnect: Xiriirinta LinkedIn ? Isku xidhka ayaa joogsada oo calaamadihii gelitaanka waa la tirtiray. Liidhiyeyaasha, xisaabaadka iyo diiwaanka hawlaha waa la hayaa.
connection.noPermission: Waxaad arki kartaa boggan. Isku xidhka iyo bedelida habayntu waxay u baahantahay ogolaanshaha "Maamul Settings".
connection.fetchTitle: Ku soo hel hogamiyeyaasha kala duwanaanta taariikhda
connection.fetchHint: Hogaamiyeyaasha cusub ayaa la hubiyaa dhowrkii daqiiqoba mar, 7da maalmood ee u dambeeyana dib ayaa loo hubiyaa maalin kasta, markaa waxba lama seegin. U isticmaal kan horseed ka hor inta aanad isku xidhin, ama si aad mar kale u hubiso muddo (ilaa 90 maalmood markiiba). Leadrat horaa loo booday.
connection.fetchResult: {{from}} - {{to}} : {{received}} la helay, {{created}} la sameeyay, {{duplicates}} nuqul ka mid ah, {{rejected}} la diiday, {{skipped}} mar hore la soo dejiyay.

capi.title: Conversions API
capi.intro: U sheeg LinkedIn midkee hoggaankeedu noqday rajooyin dhab ah. Marka hogaanka LinkedIn uu gaaro heerka aad dooratay hoos, Leadrat wuxuu u warbixiyaa LinkedIn , si warbixinahaaga ololaha ay muujiyaan tayada rasaasta iyo LinkedIn waxay heli kartaa dad badan oo la mid ah hoggaankaaga ugu fiican. Kaliya ID hogaanka LinkedIn iyo hash hal-jid ah ee iimaylka ayaa la soo diraa.
capi.noRules: Weli wax khariidad ah lama samayn
capi.created: Beddelka lagu sameeyay LinkedIn oo la sameeyay.
